title: RAIOS V9.NL-0 NeuroLingua integration map
repository: GREENY LIFE Digital Operating System (GL-DOS / EOS)

architectural_conflict.expected: Existing RAIOS V9 substrate (Cognitive WAL, knowledge states, Live/Evolution Brain split, capability providers, RiskLevel verification policy, NeuroLingua scaffolding).
architectural_conflict.found: This repository is Greeny-Life EOS: a product/packaging/PIM digital operating system with a Python governance brain (brain.py) and a TypeScript unified-intelligence layer. There is no RAIOS package, no Cognitive WAL, no DISCOVERED→VALIDATED→CANONICAL machine, no NeuroLingua tree, no benchmarks/neuro_lingua/seed_cases.jsonl, and no configs/neuro_lingua/concepts.yaml prior to NL-0.
architectural_conflict.decision: Do not invent a second product brain and do not replace GreenyLifeBrain. Introduce a Python RAIOS V9 language-layer substrate under src/raios that NeuroLingua uses, reusing GL-DOS contracts (RiskLevel, capability routing, knowledge_base path, YAML config, logs/, idempotent append) where they already exist. Document every new primitive as complementary, not competing.

components.responsibility: Governance, quality, security, documentation, product-master scans. Loads config.yaml, writes logs/, maintains intelligence/knowledge_base.
components.integration_mechanism: Read-only reuse of config loader pattern, logs/ directory, and knowledge_base_path. NeuroLingua is not a replacement brain; src/raios/adapters/greeny_life.py exposes interpret as an intelligence capability.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Creating a second 'RAIOS brain' would conflict. NL-0 does not. GreenyLifeBrain remains the EOS orchestrator.

components.responsibility: Host LLM vendor block (claude), govern thresholds, brain.knowledge_base_path, security.
components.integration_mechanism: raios.config.load_neuro_lingua_config reads llm.provider/model and brain.knowledge_base_path. Does not write config.yaml (BOUND.md danger zone). NL-0 config lives in configs/neuro_lingua/.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Host llm.provider is hardcoded to claude. NeuroLingua must not adopt that as architecture; providers are capability contracts. Overlay is read-only.

components.responsibility: Forbids unreviewed edits to src/master_data, src/finance, src/auth, src/compliance, .env, config.yaml.
components.integration_mechanism: NL-0 does not modify those paths. New code is under src/raios, configs/neuro_lingua, tests/neuro_lingua, benchmarks/neuro_lingua, docs/v9, reports/.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: None if those paths stay untouched.

components.responsibility: Specified V9 local-first linguistic learning log (DISCOVERED without remote ACK).
components.integration_mechanism: Created: src/raios/wal (JSONL, idempotent event_id, local durability). Stored under intelligence/knowledge_base/neuro_lingua/ to sit beside existing knowledge_base, not under data/ (product SSOT).
components.conflicts_or_duplication: No prior WAL existed. This is not a second WAL; it is the first. Do not confuse with Prisma auditLog or intelligence/project-memory.json.

components.responsibility: Append-only JSON decision log; skip if engine+finding+decision already exist.
components.integration_mechanism: Pattern reused in raios.events.EventSink and CognitiveWAL idempotency. Python WAL is used for linguistic events because the TS memory file is product/intelligence decisions, not linguistic observations.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Writing linguistic events into project-memory.json would mix domains. NL-0 keeps a sibling JSONL instead of overloading that file.

components.existing_component: Knowledge base paths / canonical path map
components.responsibility: Canonical path map, tools manifest, project metadata. brain.py default knowledge_base_path.
components.integration_mechanism: Manifest at intelligence/knowledge_base/neuro_lingua_manifest.json. WAL/inbox under intelligence/knowledge_base/neuro_lingua/. Does not mutate knowledge-base.json canonical_paths (product SSOT).
components.conflicts_or_duplication: knowledge-base.json is a path policy for product JSON/TS, not a linguistic concept registry. Concept Registry is configs/neuro_lingua/concepts.yaml.

components.responsibility: V9 promotion policy for learned knowledge.
components.integration_mechanism: Created: src/raios/knowledge_state.py. WAL appends DISCOVERED only. Canonical promotion requires VALIDATED + allow_canonical + evidence.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Absent before NL-0. EngineStatus in intelligence/core/engine-registry.ts (ACTIVE/DISABLED/DEPRECATED) is not a knowledge state and is not reused as a substitute.

components.responsibility: Capability name → execute; CAPABILITY_NOT_REGISTERED / graceful failure; never mutates Master Data.
components.integration_mechanism: Python mirror: src/raios/providers (CapabilityContract, ProviderRegistry, cheapest capable provider). NeuroLinguaCapability adapter matches the TS IntelligenceCapability shape.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: A second TS registry was not added. Python registry is required because the public NL-0 API is Python. Host config.yaml llm.provider=claude is explicitly not the routing key.

components.responsibility: Lists TS intelligence engines (duplicate, cleanup, audit, memory).
components.integration_mechanism: Not extended: engines listed there are invoked by TS scan scripts. NeuroLingua is Python. Discovery is via neuro_lingua_manifest.json.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Registering a Python kernel as a TS engine would break runDuplicateEngine-style loaders.

components.responsibility: riskLevel LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL. CRITICAL denied without human auth; HIGH review required.
components.integration_mechanism: src/raios/risk.py mirrors the same four names. Semantic verification policy in src/raios/neuro_lingua/verification.py escalates checks by that taxonomy. Does not reimplement the TS governance gate (execution authorization ≠ semantic verification).
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Verification policy was NOT already scaffolded in Python. TS gate is authorization, not number/entity/terminology preservation. NL-0 adds semantic verification without replacing the gate.

components.responsibility: No Python or TS pub/sub event bus exists.
components.integration_mechanism: Minimal in-process EventSink (src/raios/events.py) used by WAL and Evolution inbox. Not a distributed bus.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Would be a competing bus only if we introduced Redis/NATS/etc. We did not.

components.responsibility: Canonical meaning boundary.
components.integration_mechanism: Created: src/raios/neuro_lingua/packet.py. Application API consumes meaning, not vendor output.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: None pre-existing.

components.responsibility: Specified for changing facts → retrieval.
components.integration_mechanism: No product RAG exists (no vector index, no chunk store). sentence-transformers is in requirements.txt but unused by EOS runtime. NL-0 training policy routes changing facts to retrieval as a decision, and does not install or download embedding models in tests.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Do not treat requirements.txt sentence-transformers as an existing RAG stack. Training policy names retrieval without calling it.

components.path: config.yaml llm.provider; brain.py optional claude/npx claude
components.responsibility: Host brain optionally shells out to claude. Not capability-contract based.
components.integration_mechanism: GenericLLMProvider is vendor-agnostic and unconfigured by default (unavailable). LocalDeterministicProvider is the NL-0 default. Host claude settings are read as metadata only.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Hard-wiring NeuroLingua to claude would violate 'model is replaceable'. We did not.

components.responsibility: Master Data reads are authoritative; reports are derived; governance gates execution.
components.integration_mechanism: NeuroLingua never writes product Master Data. Reports for NL-0 go to reports/v9-*.json following the existing reports/ derived-artifact convention.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: None.

components.responsibility: Vitest workflow engine (Prisma mocked), TS intelligence tests, k6 smoke, Prisma entity live test.
components.integration_mechanism: Python NL-0 suite added at tests/neuro_lingua with pytest (new, because no pytest suite existed). Does not modify Vitest or Prisma tests. pytest.ini pythonpath=src. Does not run test_db_entities.py (needs PostgreSQL).
components.conflicts_or_duplication: No prior pytest layout. Adding pytest.ini is scoped to tests/neuro_lingua via testpaths.

components.responsibility: Console + logs/brain-YYYYMMDD.log. Architecture phase JSON under unified-intelligence/reports/.
components.integration_mechanism: src/raios/observability.py writes logs/neuro-lingua-YYYYMMDD.log with the same formatter. Benchmark/test JSON in reports/ like other derived artifacts.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Does not create a second metrics backend (no Prometheus/OTel added).

components.responsibility: Returns hardcoded 100/95/85/60.
components.integration_mechanism: NeuroLingua Confidence is measured from evidence (script ratios, lexical hit counts). Missing tiers recorded in unavailable_tiers. Does not call calculateConfidence.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: Reusing the TS helper would fake confidence. Explicitly avoided.

components.responsibility: V9 principle: live inference vs evolution/learning.
components.integration_mechanism: Live path: NeuroLingua.interpret/realize. Evolution path: EvolutionInbox JSONL (learning gaps). No training is started.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: These brains did not exist. Inbox is an integration point, not a second EOS brain.

components.responsibility: Placeholder merged_skills list.
components.integration_mechanism: Training policy routes repeated procedures to COMPILED_SKILL without writing weights or mutating tools_manifest.json in NL-0.
components.conflicts_or_duplication: tools_manifest.merged_skills is empty; NL-0 does not populate it automatically.
